description: This file defines multiple enum classes representing various user preferences and settings for an Android application, including layout, theme, color scheme, sorting, backup, deletion timing, date/time formats, media opening options, font size, UI modes, cloud services, sync options, and security preferences.

classes.name: LayoutMode
classes.description: Enumeration for different layout modes (Grid or List) with associated resource IDs.

classes.name: ThemeMode
classes.description: Enumeration for theme modes (System, Dark, Light) with associated resource IDs and mode constants.

classes.name: DarkThemeMode
classes.description: Enumeration for dark theme styles (Standard, Black) with resource IDs.

classes.name: ColorScheme
classes.description: Enumeration for color schemes with resource IDs and support requirement for system version.

classes.name: SortMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for different sorting methods with resource IDs, default is MODIFIED_DESC.

classes.name: SortTagsMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for sorting tags with resource IDs.

classes.name: SortNavdrawerNotebooksMethod
classes.description: Enumeration for sorting notebooks in navigation drawer with resource IDs.

classes.name: BackupStrategy
classes.description: Enumeration for backup strategies with resource IDs.

classes.name: NoteDeletionTime
classes.description: Enumeration for note deletion timing with resource IDs and interval in seconds.

classes.name: DateFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for date format patterns with resource IDs.

classes.name: TimeFormat
classes.description: Enumeration for time format patterns with resource IDs.

classes.name: OpenMediaIn
classes.description: Enumeration for media opening options (Internal or External) with resource IDs.

classes.name: ShowDate
classes.description: Enumeration for showing date (Yes or No) with resource IDs.

classes.name: FontSize
classes.description: Enumeration for font sizes with resource IDs and size values.

classes.name: ShowFabChangeMode
classes.description: Enumeration for FAB change modes (FAB or Topbar) with resource IDs.

classes.name: GroupNotesWithoutNotebook
classes.description: Enumeration for grouping notes without notebook (Yes or No) with resource IDs.

classes.name: MoveCheckedItems
classes.description: Enumeration for moving checked items (Yes or No) with resource IDs.

classes.name: DefaultEditorMode
classes.description: Enumeration for default editor mode (View or Edit) with resource IDs.

classes.name: CloudService
classes.description: Enumeration for cloud services (Disabled, Nextcloud, File Storage) with resource IDs.

classes.name: SyncMode
classes.description: Enumeration for sync modes (WiFi or Always) with resource IDs.

classes.name: BackgroundSync
classes.description: Enumeration for background sync (Enabled or Disabled) with resource IDs.

classes.name: NewNotesSyncable
classes.description: Enumeration for whether new notes are syncable (Yes or No) with resource IDs.

classes.name: TrustSelfSignedCertificate
classes.description: Enumeration for trusting self-signed certificates (No or Yes) with resource IDs.
